purpose: Resolves the Commission default embedded-emissions value for a (CN code x country-of-origin) pair, applies the year-dependent markup vs the actual-data path (+10% 2026, +20% 2027, +30% 2028+), and returns the value with provenance citing the CBAM Implementing Regulation.
